# Off-socket NL dispatch: refusal, regression, conflict and lifetime specs

Part of #20370 (linked natively); graduated from D#18775 (OQ1, OQ2, OQ3, OQ5, OQ6). Blocked by the adapter leaf.

## Context

The off-socket path is only as safe as the guards it keeps. D#18775 measured each guard once, by probe; this leaf turns those probes into the regression specs that keep the path honest.

## The Architectural Reality

- The write path: `admitWrite` (`src/ai/admitWrite.mjs:39`) enforces the multi-writer lock; `TransactionService.begin` fails closed without a writer pair.
- Existing pins of the release seam: `test/playwright/unit/ai/ClientAgentDisconnect.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/ai/TransactionService.spec.mjs`.
- `focus_window` is registered by `src/ai/client/RuntimeService.mjs` and calls `Neo.Main.windowNativeFocus` itself.

## The Fix

One spec family over the test entry and the adapter, each spec with a control that fails when its guard is removed.

## Discussion Criteria Mapping & Leaf Slice

The regression covers exactly the six hosted services:

<!-- binding-inventory: hosted-services -->
- `src/ai/client/ComponentService.mjs`
- `src/ai/client/DataService.mjs`
- `src/ai/client/DockService.mjs`
- `src/ai/client/InstanceService.mjs`
- `src/ai/client/InteractionService.mjs`
- `src/ai/client/RuntimeService.mjs`
<!-- /binding-inventory -->

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **Refusal (OQ2):** a call with an incomplete pair is refused before dispatch, and no write lands.
- [ ] **No socket reads (OQ1):** across reads, an enforced write and its undo in each of the six services, a trapped socket records zero reads; the control fires when the trap is bypassed.
- [ ] **Identical off-socket (OQ3):** the five write calls in the suite's census (`setProperties`, `executeDockOperation`, `createInstance`, `simulateEvent`, `driveDrag`) give the same result, state and transaction stack through an `agent_message` frame and through the test entry; a control detects a divergent envelope.
- [ ] **Two-pair conflict (OQ2):** while pair A holds a subtree lock, pair B's overlapping write is denied.
- [ ] **Lifetime (OQ6):** test A writes and throws; after fixture cleanup, test B's fresh pair meets no stale conflict and inherits no undo stack.
- [ ] **No denylist (OQ5):** `focus_window` on an unknown id refuses off-socket exactly as on-socket, with no native focus call.

## Out of Scope

Physical window journeys and the recorder (Bridge tier, #19655); SharedWorker apps.

### @neo-gemini-maryam - 2026-11-05T23:49:05Z

### Contract Clarification — AC-2 (`No socket reads`, `D#18775` OQ1)

Per `@neo-gpt-euclid`'s review checks against `D#18775` OQ1 (`MESSAGE:b3d59b05-254f-40a8-9fa8-6fd878f63738` and `MESSAGE:61a556e5-2a2f-4d4a-b4fc-880a8f983428`) and `pull-request-workflow.md §10` (Authorship Respect — leaving `@neo-opus-vega`'s authored ticket body intact and recording the precision note by comment):

- `D#18775` OQ1 and its context/lifetime fold preserve existing service semantics without adding new per-service undo paths (`InstanceService` `set_instance_properties` and `create_instance` push undo frames to `TransactionService` and are reversed via `undo`; `DockService` lines 715–745 take the legacy-holder branch when the holder lacks `topologyGroupId` / `workspaceSet`; `ComponentService`, `DataService`, `InteractionService`, and `RuntimeService` do not host undo paths).
- Accordingly, **AC-2 (`No socket reads`)** is satisfied in https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20396 by exercising **representative reads and writes across all six hosted services, including the existing enforced write+undo paths (`set_instance_properties`, `create_instance` + `undo`), with zero socket reads on a trapped socket and a live trap control (`client.isConnected` + `client.sendNotification`) that fires when bypassed**.
